state.persona: Sam, 34, invited friend. Got a link in a group chat from their friend Matt. Has never used dope.travel. On an iPhone, no account, no prior data on this device.
state.job: Understand what this is and who invited me, say who I am, vote on trip ideas, and get my votes back to Matt.
state.workflow_state: Just tapped the invite link. Page /trips/join on a 390x844 phone.
state.visible_text: Header: 'dope.travel' logo, search icon, 'Profile'. Banner: 'Set your traveler lens. It takes under a minute.' [Begin] [Skip]. Eyebrow: 'SHARED TRIP'. Headline: 'Matt wants you on this trip. Lisbon.' Lede: 'Thu, Oct 15 → Tue, Oct 20 · 5 nights. Say who you are, tap ♥ on what you're into, and send your picks back. No sign-up: the trip came inside the link.' Panel 'WHO ARE YOU?' with two chips: '😎 Matt' and '🌺 Sam'. 'Not on the list? Add yourself' text input placeholder 'Your name'. Primary button 'Join and vote →'. Bottom tab bar: World, Circles, People, Access, More.
state.not_visible: No explanation of what dope.travel is, no preview of the plan or ideas, no note that picking a name lets you vote as that person, no note about what is stored on the device.

knows_inviter.instructions: Probability Sam correctly understands that Matt invited them to help plan a Lisbon trip for Oct 15-20.

knows_next_step.instructions: Probability Sam knows the next steps are: tap their own name (Sam), press Join and vote, then vote on ideas and send picks back.

might_pick_wrong.instructions: Probability a typical invited friend taps a name other than their own (e.g. the organizer Matt, because it is listed first or they think it means 'join Matt') at least once in this screen.

lens_banner.instructions: What will Sam most likely do with the 'Set your traveler lens' banner on this screen?

criteria.ignore: Ignore it and continue with the invite
criteria.tap_begin: Tap Begin thinking it is part of joining the trip
criteria.confused_stop: Get confused about which is the real next step and hesitate
